title: Jet Lag Skin Soothing Hydration Mist

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, fragranceFree, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Fragrance Free✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Hydrating✓ Vegan

What it is: Refresh your skincare routine with a dose of dewy hydration. This ultra-fine mist soothes, provides moisture barrier support, and leaves skin glowing.


Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily


Skincare Concerns: Dryness


Formulation: Lightweight Serum


Highlighted Ingredients:
- Glycerin: Is a protective ingredient that attracts and holds water in even the driest skin.

- Skin-Soothing Complex: Calms, comforts, and soothes.

- Skin-Barrier-Support Complex: Naturally protects skin-barrier health.


Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.

How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-With your eyes closed, gently mist onto skin, holding the bottle 12 inches away from your face.
-Use as the first step in your skincare routine, after makeup, or as needed throughout the day.
Ingredients+

-Glycerin: Is a protective ingredient that attracts and holds water in even the driest skin.

-Skin-Soothing Complex: Calms, comforts, and soothes.

-Skin-Barrier-Support Complex: Naturally protects skin barrier health.


Water/Aqua/Eau, Glycerin, Propanediol, Pentylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Panthenol, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Ceramide NP, Ectoin, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Allantoin, Squalane, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Olea Europaea (Olive) Fruit Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Butylene Glycol, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Behenyl Alcohol, Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Inulin Lauryl Carbamate, Glycolipids, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Methyl Diisopropyl Propionamide, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Tocopherol


The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
